# concat

> Concatenate two strings (wraps String.prototype.concat).

<section class="intro">

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var concat = require( '@stdlib/string/base/concat' );
```

#### concat( str1, str2 )

Concatenates `str1` and `str2` and returns the concatenated string.

```javascript
var s = concat( 'beep', 'boop' );
// returns 'beepboop'
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var concat = require( '@stdlib/string/base/concat' );

var s = concat( 'foo', 'bar' );
// returns 'foobar'

s = concat( 'hello', ' world' );
// returns 'hello world'

s = concat( '', 'empty' );
// returns 'empty'

s = concat( 'a', '' );
// returns 'a'
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
